 All For One Low PriceDaytime Cruises
	

 
 Join the Ultimate Family Adventure: 2-Hour Dolphin Fun Cruise with Water Wars and a One-of-a-Kind Sea-Life Experience! Get wet or stay dry, your choice.
Price:Passengers (AGES 12+) – $26 (+tax)Passengers (AGES 2 to 11) – $21 (+tax)INFANTS UNDER AGE 2 – $15 (+tax)
*Prices subject to change

 
 
 Book Now!
 
 
 
	

 
 

	

 
	
	
 
	
	
 
 
 
 
 
	
 All For One Low PriceSunset Cruises
	

 
 Enjoy a fantastic 2-hour dolphin cruise, our educational sea-life experience, water wars, and dolphin combined with the ambiance of a beautiful Gulf Coast Sunset.
PriceSunset Passengers (AGES 12 and up) – $30 (+tax)Sunset Passengers (AGES 11 and under incl. infants) – $21 (+tax)
*Prices subject to change

 
 
 Book Now!
 
 
 
	

 
 

	

	
 
	

	
 
 

 
	

 
	
	
 

	All For One Price On Every Cruise!All For One Price On Every Cruise!
	
	

	
 
	DOLPHIN CRUISE + SEA-LIFE EXPERIENCE + WATER FIGHT
HAVE MORE FUN ON VACATION
The water fight is a ton of fun for all ages and is COMPLETELY OPTIONAL. Both boats have a cabin for those who choose to STAY DRY! Whether you choose to participate in the water fight or prefer to stay dry, this family-friendly experience is sure to bring lots of fun and laughter. *Typically during the off-season only one boat goes out.

	

	
 
	

	
 
 

 
	
	
 

	
	

 
	
	
 
	Previous
 
 
 We did the sunset cruise and had a great time. Really appreciated the family-friendly atmosphere. Captain Dean and his crew were top-notch too, sharing multiple tidbits on the history of the area and marine life. Will definitely do it again next time we are in the area!

 Great time. Captain and crew were amazing. Our three year old grandson loved it. Highly recommend

 This is a regular excursion for us when we are in Orange Beach. The crew is awesome! We love the family friendly atmosphere. We always get to see dolphins! 
 M. G.11/10/2024 
 
 
 
 
 This is a must for any family trip to the area. Perfect for those young in age & young at heart. Had a blast. Would go again. 
 E. M.12/10/2024 
 
 
 
 
 We had the most fun today! The captain and deck hands are warm and personable, as well as knowledgeable! We saw beautiful dolphins, learned hands on about sea creatures, and had a water fight on deck, all while supporting a family friendly, Christian business! Highly recommend!!! 
 T. M.11/10/2024 
 
 
 
 
 Absolutely loved this experience! Loved how they get the dolphins to "play"! My granddaughter loved getting to hold a shrimp, fish and other things! Looking for a clean family outing? This is definitely it! Everyone was kind and we learned a lot!

 About Us
	
	

	
 
	The captain and crew work hard to give your family a unique, one of a kind excursion that you will only get on The Fun Boats. We strive to give our guest a FUN, Exciting and memorable experience while on our boats! After all, a dolphin cruise is great but throw in a sealife experience and a water fight and it's EPIC! What are you waiting for. Join us today!
Read More About The Fun Boats™ Dolphin Cruises

	

	
 
 HAVE MORE FUN ON VACATION
	
	

	
 
	
Our boats have restrooms
Inside/Outside seating
Life jackets for all passengers
Drinks and snacks for purchase
We can go in the Gulf!
If there is bad weather you will be refunded or rescheduled
